# Greeting

Says hello on the server's own log, in whatever tone you set.

It draws nothing. What it is here for is its **knobs**: a `Config` with one of
each control the settings reader draws — a short choice, a switch, a bounded
integer and a long choice — so the controls under *Settings* on the plugin's
own page and in its row on the plugins panel have something real to write, and
an out-of-range number has something real to refuse.
